_contract: garment-spec v2 — SEALED 2026-08-17 (H2.1). K1 discipline: this file is the SINGLE SOURCE. contract/garment-spec-v2.schema.json is GENERATED from it by engine/tools/gen-spec-v2.mjs; consumers never copy values out of here by hand, and engine/tools/specv2-check.mjs (ctest: specv2_check) fails if the generated schema drifts, if an operator's engine binding has vanished, or if a declared quantity's default no longer matches engine/src/surfacepattern.hpp. It replaces contract/garment-spec-v2.DRAFT.md (12 Ağu), whose topology/quantity split is kept and whose scope was re-measured against the engine of 17 Ağu.
_law: 1. AN LLM WRITES JSON, NEVER CODE. Every topology axis is a CLOSED enum; every quantity is a bounded scalar with a unit. additionalProperties is false everywhere in the generated schema. A field the schema does not declare is a rejection, not a warning.

2. NO SILENT SUBSTITUTION. DERSLER: a quiet enum fallback (puff -> None) is hallucination. If a requested enum value is not in the registry as `shipped`, the spec is REFUSED and the refusal names the operator. Never the nearest neighbour, never a default.

3. THE REGISTRY IS THE SCOPE. `operators` below is the sicil. An enum value declares which operators it requires. A spec is expressible if and only if every operator it requires has status `shipped`. This is the machine side of the bitiş tanımı: 'the remaining two refuse honestly, naming the missing operator'.

4. SOLVER KNOBS ARE NOT SPEC. `solverKnobs` lists the numerical dials of the flattener. They are declared here so nobody re-declares them elsewhere, and they are EXCLUDED from the generated schema — an LLM/VLM that writes arapRounds is writing code, and rule 1 forbids it.
5. NOTHING IS WRITTEN HERE THAT THE ENGINE CANNOT DO. An operator with no engine binding today carries status `absent` and says so in its own line. A field with a fake capability is a painted gate.

_statuses.shipped: runs on the DEFAULT path the buyer receives today (surface-pattern with a default-constructed SheathOptions). Binding is a real symbol in engine/src/surfacepattern.hpp.
_statuses.flagged: the code exists and is measured, but it is switched OFF in the shipped configuration because turning it on breaks a green gate. A spec requiring it is REFUSED — an unshippable capability is not a capability.
_statuses.absent: SİCİLDE YOK. No engine symbol, no derivative, no approximation. A spec requiring it is REFUSED and the refusal names it.

_serh._role: ŞERH = sicile düşülen ölçülmüş çelişki notu. Status DEĞİŞTİRMEZ, kapı DEĞİŞTİRMEZ; sicilin hangi motoru anlattığını, artefaktın hangi motoru sevk ettiğini yazar. Bir şerhi silmek, çelişkinin ölçülerek kapandığını göstermeyi gerektirir.

topology._role: AYRIK katman. Her eksen KAPALI enum; her değer gerektirdiği operatörleri `requires` ile ilan eder. Bir değer, gerektirdiği operatörlerden biri `shipped` değilse İFADE EDİLEMEZ ve red o operatörün ADIYLA verilir.

quantities._role: SÜREKLİ katman. Her kadran bir SheathOptions alanına bağlı; `default` o alanın engine/src/surfacepattern.hpp'deki bugünkü değeridir ve specv2_check onu başlıktan okuyup karşılaştırır (sürüklenirse KIRMIZI). Sınırlar İLAN EDİLMİŞ tasarım bandıdır, ölçülmüş kanun değil — kaynağı olan `source` taşır.
